answer: Reputation then accrues only to identities surviving to an epoch zenith, making fake accounts expensive to sustain. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work staking tied to verifiable resource burn: each new agent identity must submit a stake that passes through a single audited inlet contract, where it is locked and time-decayed much like a glacier releases meltwater slowly, so mass-registering identities drains capital at a rising marginal cost. From sa0019's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
